ananya.name: Dr. Ananya

Shoulder-length black hair tied in a low bun with a few loose strands, slim build, small gold stud earrings, a stethoscope worn around her neck (never in use) in every scene where she wears the white coat (manga supplement, from the accepted reference sheet).

Soft, straight medium-thick eyebrows set fairly level
Oval face with a defined, slightly pointed chin and a small bindi-free forehead; small nose with a rounded tip

script.style: Full-colour, approachable Indian slice-of-life manga. Clean confident line art with varied line weight, soft flat cel shading, warm natural daylight, restrained blue and teal accents, simple readable backgrounds. Expressive but natural faces, precise hands. No photorealism, no glossy gradients, no surface microtexture. Absolutely no text, letters, logos, numbers, speech bubbles or captions inside the artwork; device screens show only abstract blank blocks and simple icons.
script.continuity: Keep Dr. Ananya, Meera, Ravi, the Nurse, Mr. Raman, Priya, the Pharmacist and the Lab Technician identical to their canonical reference sheets in face traits, hair, build, skin tone and clothing for the whole comic. Device screens never show readable text or real personal data. Page 9 panels 2-3 (09-2, 09-3) are a future vision: soft pale-blue vignette border and lighter, airy palette so they never read as current features.

pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-08.png with Read and looked at it. It has no numbers. The figures are grey placeholder boxes with name labels. The page has three tiers. In the bottom tier, a tall panel on the left sits beside two stacked panels on the right. Natural reading order: (1) Top-left panel. Caption in the top-left corner: "Meanwhile, the pharmacy is notified and fills the prescription." Below it, a teal label: "NEW PRESCRIPTION". To the right is the 'pharmacist' placeholder, silent. (2) Top-right panel. Caption in the top-right corner: "The lab is notified." Below it, a teal label: "LAB ORDER: samples to collect". To the left of the label is the 'labtech' placeholder, silent. (3) Full-width middle panel. Caption at the top left: "Later that day, Ravi gives his samples at the clinic lab." The 'ravi' placeholder sits left of centre and is silent. Balloon at the top right, with its tail to the 'labtech' placeholder: "All done, Ravi! We'll let you know when your results are ready." (4) Tall bottom-left panel. Caption: "Results ready: Ravi is notified." Teal label: "Welbuk Health app · email · WhatsApp". The 'ravi' placeholder is below, silent. (5) Upper-right bottom panel. Caption: "Dr. Ananya is notified on Welbuk Care." Teal label: "RESULTS READY". The 'ananya' placeholder is on the right, silent. (6) Lower-right bottom panel. Caption: "The clinic is notified on Welbuk Practice." The 'meera' placeholder is in the middle, silent. Teal label at the top right: "RESULTS READY". Page number "8" at the bottom.
pages.observation: 1. The order is clear. Each panel has only one caption, plus one balloon or label, and they are not close enough to one another to cause a skip. The page has only one spoken line: the labtech's line in panel 3. It needs no reply, and none is missing. Ravi's silence works as a reaction. 2. In the bottom tier the reader goes from the tall left panel to the upper right and then the lower right. This is the expected tall-left/stacked-right order, so I hesitated very little. 3. Text is tight against box borders in several places. In caption 1, 'fills' almost touches the right edge of the caption box. In panel 3, 'his' in the caption ends just inside the right border. In panel 5, 'on' sits close to the right border of the caption. In the balloon, 'ready.' gets close to the curve at the right. 4. The caption boxes in panels 1, 2, 5 and 6 sit flush against the panel borders. 5. The apostrophe in the balloon renders with a gap ('We' ll'). The label 'Welbuk Health app ·' breaks after the middle dot, so a separator dangles at the end of the line. 6. In panel 6, the 'meera' placeholder label touches the left edge of the RESULTS READY box. 7. Panel 6 introduces 'the clinic', but no caption names who the person is. Final art will need to make it clear that this is a clinic staff member. No text was unreadable.
